title: Teri's Additions
description: A neoforge mod adding fun stuff to Backtanked server.
body:
A neoforge mod adding fun stuff to [Backtanked](https://discord.gg/4naJNnCya4) server.

# Why?
I wanna add some fun limited items to Backtanked server to enhance the overall experience.
I also wanted to make this mod available on Modrinth, so that everyone can use it and make it easier to update.

# What does it add?
- **Accela** - A powerful neuro-accelerator that enhances your cognitive abilities.
- **Cigarette** - A traditional cigarette. Smoking it may have some effects on your health.


I will add more stuff as time goes on.

# Can I use it in my modpack?
Sure, the entire project is licensed under MIT. There might be some assets or some other things that might have a different license but I'll try my best to keep things simple :)
